mapper.sql: FROM user u LEFT JOIN member m ON u.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN user_grade ug ON m.grade_id = ug.grade_id

where.if: AND ( u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT u.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nickname AS nickname, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, u.birth_date AS birthDate, u.gender AS gender, u.zipcode AS zipcode, u.address AS address, u.address2 AS address2, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.updated_date AS updatedDate, u.last_login_date AS lastLoginDate, u.member_status AS memberStatus, u.member_type AS memberType, COALESCE(ug.grade_name, '-') AS gradeName
ORDER BY u.member_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nickname AS nickname, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, u.birth_date AS birthDate, u.gender AS gender, u.zipcode AS zipcode, u.address AS address, u.address2 AS address2, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.updated_date AS updatedDate, u.last_login_date AS lastLoginDate, u.member_status AS memberStatus, u.member_type AS memberType, COALESCE(ug.grade_name, '-') AS gradeName
WHERE u.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET member_status = #{memberStatus}, status_reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
